briefing.headline: Nvidia has reported strong Q3 results, while its board says it will not bring back Jensen Huang as CEO, and AI stocks are swinging lower.

points.text: Nvidia's board says it unanimously accepted Jensen Huang's resignation and does not intend to reinstate him as CEO.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia reported Q3 fiscal 2027 revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% from a year ago. Data center revenue was $107.6 billion, up 110%.
points.label: reported

points.text: Colette Kress, now interim CEO, announced the Q3 results. Early coverage said the results met expectations.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia and other AI stocks swung lower again on Wall Street, adding to a rough stretch for the sector.
points.label: reported

points.text: Anthropic is pushing ahead with its IPO, and reports say it may price above the $70 to $78 range.
points.label: reported
